concept: The choices you make actually change what happens next
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character's small choice leads directly to a different outcome than a different choice would have
exercise.reflection_prompt: What would have happened if the character had chosen differently?
exercise.practice: Student names one choice they made today and what it led to

assessment.success_marker: student connects a real choice to a real outcome, not just describing an event
